submission.body:
### Findings

The full migration from the old materialization/decision layer to the new `src/decision` package is **incomplete** across the repository:

1. **Completed (`group_a` scope)**:
   - Added `src/decision/commands.ts`, `src/decision/derive.ts`, `src/decision/ids.ts`, and `src/decision/snapshot.ts`.
   - Added the test fixture helper `tests/decision/snapshot-builder.ts`.

2. **Missing / Incomplete across the rest of the repository**:
   - **Unit tests for `derive` are missing**: `tests/decision/snapshot-builder.ts` exists (and references test cases such as case 12), but there is no `tests/decision/derive.test.ts` (or equivalent test file) exercising `derive`.
   - **Old materialization and decision modules have not been removed or replaced**:
     - `src/compiler/select-unit-inputs.ts` still exists (despite `src/decision/commands.ts` noting `"StageInputSet moves here from compiler/select-unit-inputs.ts, which is deleted in the same PR"`).
     - `src/compiler/materialize-stage.ts` and `src/compiler/materialize-units.ts` still exist alongside their old tests (`tests/materialize-stage.test.ts`, `tests/materialize-units.test.ts`, and `tests/dev-flow-stage-contracts.test.ts`).
     - `src/domain/run-decisions.ts` and `tests/run-decisions.test.ts` still use the old `RunDecision` / `selectRunDecision` model instead of `AskResult` / `derive`.
     - `src/runtime/run-materialization.ts` and `src/storage/repositories.ts` still implement and reference the old `reconcileRunMaterialization` / `persist_materialized_stage` flow and do not wire in `src/decision`.

### Verification

- `tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json` passes.
- `bun test` passes (86 passing tests), but only covers the pre-existing test suite; `src/decision/derive.ts` is not yet exercised by any test or wired into runtime/storage.
submission.title: Incomplete migration to `src/decision`: missing derive tests and runtime/compiler/domain cutover
